semanticReview.method: Inspección del informe metodológico oficial del NIKL, cotejo del ejemplo y reescritura acotada a la distinción documentada.
findings: The NIKL grammar report explicitly states that the negative forms of **-어도 되다** are **-지 않아도 되다** and **안 -어도 되다**; it illustrates both with **밥을 먹지 않아도 돼요**, **커피를 마시지 않아도 돼요**, and **커피를 안 마셔도 돼요**. It distinguishes these as permission not to perform an action (absence of obligation) from **-(으)면 안 되다**, which expresses prohibition. The distinction is contextual: “no tienes que” does not mean “está prohibido”.
